limitations: synthetic drawings share the generator author's drafting assumptions (one hatch per meaning, legend rows to the right of the building, pits inside the largest footing)

the held-out vocabulary words are mostly in the engine's lexicon (FAMILY_TOKENS / SCOPE_WORDS): held-out tests generalisation over names the development seeds never drew, not over words the engine does not know
W1 (unbound marks) has no synthetic case: the generator cannot draw a mark between two parallel bands; it is tested by a hand-built fixture and on ST7757 (post-discovery)
the false-finding classification is post hoc and does not change the counts above
